title: The Giggle We'd Been Waiting For
desc: You laughed, really laughed, for the first time, and it was the most beautiful sound these walls have ever heard. Nothing could have prepared us for how completely it would undo us.
story: Nobody warned us that a baby's first giggle could stop time the way yours did. It came out of nowhere, a soft, bubbly little sound that lasted barely two seconds, but it echoed around the room like something much bigger. I think I was making a silly face, the kind I would never make in front of another adult, when your whole face scrunched up and out it tumbled. We both went completely still, scared that breathing too loud might end it. Then we tried desperately to get it again, doing every ridiculous thing we could think of, funny voices, silly dances, exaggerated peek-a-boos. And when it came again, even smaller than the first, we celebrated like it was the greatest thing either of us had ever witnessed.
